dslRule:
<!id: system.lineSeparator.property>
<!description: Replace System.getProperty("line.separator") with System.lineSeparator(). The latter has no security checks and is available since Java 7 (baseline Java 8).
>
<!severity: HINT>
java.lang.System.getProperty("line.separator")
=> java.lang.System.lineSeparator()
;;
